## Experience

- Cooklist, Lead Platform Engineer (Dec 2025 – present): Owns the GKE platform (production, staging, DR) behind agentic search and AI chat used by enterprise grocery retailers. Built per-PR ephemeral environments, a trunk-based release pipeline with migration gates, an LLM-reviewed database migration check, queue-aware autoscaling (KEDA, HPA on custom Prometheus metrics), a zero-downtime edge cutover to Traefik Gateway behind Cloud Armor, self-hosted CI runners on GKE spot nodes, and enterprise SSO with group-synced permissions.
- Pager, Lead Platform Engineer (May 2022 – Nov 2025): Led a team of five. Migrated 60 services to modern continuous deployment (90% shorter lead time, 1,800 hours / $216K saved per year). Spinnaker to Harness with canary and blue/green. On-prem to GCP migration. PostgreSQL to CloudSQL (p95 −50%, $80K saved). $113K/year cloud cost savings. HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance.
- Cerner, Senior SRE / Senior System Engineer / System Engineer (2017 – 2022): Weekly patching for 200+ Kubernetes clusters across Department of Defense, Veterans Affairs, and on-prem. Kubernetes on vSphere, OpenStack, EC2, and EKS via infrastructure as code. 1,000+ Linux servers with Chef.
- Zebra Technologies, Senior DevOps Engineer (2021): Dynatrace observability across Kubernetes and microservices.

## How he works with AI

- Runs coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) in parallel git worktrees, one ticket per agent, with sub-agents for research, tests, and review.
- Roughly doubled merged PRs per month after moving to parallel agents; about 63% of his merged PRs in 2026 are AI co-authored.
- Authored 15 reusable agent skills shared across tools: incident triage, postmortem drafting, read-only database access, CI fixing, PR review handling, and session handoff.
- Guardrails: diagnose read-only first, staging before production, and nothing merges without human approval.
